body: We could add a comment to inform that we simulate the `start` event of the `SpeechRecognition`.

We re-use the exact same implementation multiple times inside the test. We could have a function that create the mock version of `SpeechRecognition` (like we do for [the client or the helper](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/61ae52c9b1b29f812844c00d1b44eca3be929a9f/src/connectors/query-rules/__tests__/connectQueryRules-test.ts#L31-L43)). You can store the [`listeners`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3779/files#diff-7fd428b5c85af5b43d66125872408774R70) directly on the `SpeechRecognition` mock to avoid to return multiple values from the function.
We should also stop listening once we dispose the widget.

I'm not sure if [this](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3779/commits/aa4f1bbb9540fcd8b86d1577e43d42c6600e09fe) is what you meant by storing the listeners directly on the SpeechRecognition mock.
I didn't mention it into my original comment, but it worth adding it on the others listeners calls.
Not sure the `resetState` call is useful, the Helper is destroyed with the widget anyway.

I wasn't sure about this. I've removed it now and changed the way to test it.
https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3779/commits/ae1f20e93ceffacbd4e67be83b6baaefae858f24
reads pretty weird, I think we can keep `dispose` (maybe even in backticks to signify the fact that it's a function)
I think the comments might become redundant if we call this `simulateListener`
What was wrong with this assertion? IMO it was better because we weren't relying on implementation detail.

`isListening` relies on `voiceSearchHelper.getState().status`.
Since we're not updating the `state` of `voiceSearchHelper` on `dispose`, the `status` will remain as `recognizing` which results `isListening` returning `true`. And that way we cannot test this. So I had to check if `stop` has been called.

I had to make them a mock function due to [this](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3779/files/af65fcd0e9c1ce8122a3e1f39a3aaaa2ef68c97a..ae1f20e93ceffacbd4e67be83b6baaefae858f24#r284716504)

haha okay. I've reverted it back to disposal with backticks 👍
